en.description: Free browser tools: image compressor, QR code generator, password generator, word counter, IP & DNS checker, hash generator, JSON formatter, Base64, case converter and more. Private and fast. Your files are never uploaded.

id.description: Kumpulan alat online gratis dalam bahasa Indonesia: terbilang, kalkulator THR, pace lari, hitung umur, kompres foto, konverter JSON CSV. Berjalan di browser.
